description: §19.3.3 E-ERROR-009 (S443) — the qualified `fail AuthError.Nope` names a variant that is not in the IMPORTED user enum `AuthError` (Missing / Bad). Before S443 the built-in `AuthError` shadowed the import in the type registry, the variant set was never checked, and this compiled silently.
rationale: §19.3.3: the variant specified in a `fail` statement SHALL be a valid variant of the declared error enum type (E-ERROR-009); an error enum imported from another scrml file resolves exactly as a local one, so the imported enum's variant set governs even when its name is also a built-in error type's.
